definitions.explanation: A structure made of posts and rails or boards used to enclose an area, prevent entry, or mark a boundary. Includes fences around gardens, barriers at construction sites, and railings along paths.

examples.english: I built a fence around the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{柵|さく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}えよう→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: A child is trying to climb over the fence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}{現場|げんば}→工事現場：26202_koujigenba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柵|さく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Safety barriers have been installed around the construction site.

notes:
{柵|さく} refers to a fence, barrier, or railing — a structure with posts and rails or bars, typically with visible gaps between them.

- {柵|さく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to go over a fence
- {柵|さく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設置|せっち}する→設置する：26989_secchisuru⟧: to install a barrier
